scope: All four pinned GitHub workflow files read whole and Git-object verified. Workflows are data; no execution, publication or current remote-run claim.

findings.detail: Unlike archived Appveyor, primary GitHub CI defines Python3.8/3.10/3.11/latest/PyPy3.9 across Linux/Windows/macOS. This is a meaningful intended matrix, but no run results reviewed.

Downstream test installs editable Git default branch without the checked-out commit/ref. Pull-request run can test another revision rather than proposed change. pytest target is fetched src/pyfilefixity checkout.
Release workflow installs from TestPyPI/PyPI by unpinned package name without asserting version/hash equality to built artifact. Successful install does not prove just-published release was selected.

Release test step runs against editable checkout before building wheel/sdist. Post-publication checks install only; no package import/CLI/test assertions shown after install. Wheel runtime parity remains separate gate.

Three OS jobs upload dist under shared default artifact name, consumer downloads artifact name without explicit per-platform/hash manifest. Artifact-action version compatibility and actual merge semantics require runtime evidence; not assumed.
CodeQL workflow existence is analysis configuration, not successful finding-free execution or correctness coverage. No external reports sent.
